## Environment

- Temporal Server: 1.31.0 (`temporalio/server:1.31.0`)
- Deployment: all-in-one Docker Compose (single container, all four services)
- PostgreSQL: DigitalOcean Managed (db-s-1vcpu-1gb) with TLS required
- Clean install: databases dropped and recreated, schemas applied fresh

## Summary

When a parent workflow successfully completes a task that initiates a child workflow, there's a race condition between the workflow task completion path and the transfer queue processor. The transfer queue's `TransferStartChildExecution` task tries to update the parent workflow's mutable state to record that the child started, but the transaction has already been committed/rolled back by the completion path.

This triggers shard re-acquisition every ~5-6 seconds in a permanent loop. The child workflow gets created with only a `WorkflowExecutionStarted` event — no `WorkflowTaskScheduled` event ever gets written, so the child workflow never executes.

## Reproduction

Occurs when a parent workflow task completes successfully and initiates a child workflow. Observed with `temporal-sys-delete-namespace-workflow` starting `temporal-sys-reclaim-namespace-resources-workflow`, but likely affects any parent/child workflow combination under the right timing conditions.

## Observed Behavior

### Timeline (from server logs)

```
00:53:27  Delete-namespace workflow task starts
00:53:31  Namespace renamed successfully (local activities complete)
00:53:32-35  "Workflow is busy" errors
00:53:37  First "sql: transaction has already been committed or rolled back"
00:53:38  Shard re-acquired (churn starts)
```

The pattern repeats every ~5-6 seconds.

### Transfer Queue Error

```json
{"level":"warn","ts":"2026-05-19T00:53:37.427Z",
 "msg":"Fail to process task",
 "component":"transfer-queue-processor",
 "queue-task-type":"TransferStartChildExecution",
 "queue-task":"StartChildExecutionTask{...TargetWorkflowID: temporal-sys-reclaim-namespace-resources-workflow/smoke-test-deleted-ba6f9, InitiatedEventID: 11...}",
 "error":"UpdateWorkflowExecution operation failed. Failed to commit transaction. Error: sql: transaction has already been committed or rolled back",
 "error-type":"serviceerror.Unavailable",
 "attempt":2}
```

### Concurrent Access Indicators

Before the SQL error, logs show:

```json
{"level":"info","msg":"history client encountered error",
 "error":"Workflow is busy.",
 "service-error-type":"serviceerror.ResourceExhausted"}
```

This indicates concurrent attempts to access the parent workflow's mutable state.

### Error Pattern

Transfer task retries alternate between two errors:
1. `sql: transaction has already been committed or rolled back` (primary)
2. `context deadline exceeded` (when queue processor times out)

Each failure triggers shard re-acquisition, but the churn doesn't clear the broken state — it's a symptom, not the cause.

### Child Workflow State

The child workflow (`temporal-sys-reclaim-namespace-resources-workflow`) gets created but stalls with only 1 event in its history:

```
ID  Time                     Type
 1  2026-05-19T00:53:31Z     WorkflowExecutionStarted
```

No `WorkflowTaskScheduled` event is ever written, so the child workflow never executes.

## Root Cause Analysis

**Race condition in history service:**

1. Parent workflow task completes, writes event 11 (`StartChildWorkflowExecutionInitiated`)
2. Workflow task completion path has an open transaction on parent workflow's mutable state
3. Transfer queue processor immediately picks up `TransferStartChildExecution` task
4. Transfer task calls `UpdateWorkflowExecution` on parent to record child started
5. By the time the transfer task's transaction executes, the completion path's transaction is already committed/rolled back
6. `UpdateWorkflowExecution` fails with "transaction already committed or rolled back"
7. Error triggers shard re-acquisition
8. Shard re-acquisition doesn't clear the broken state — task retries indefinitely

**Code path:** `transfer_queue_active_task_executor.go:1090` (`processStartChildExecution`) → `recordChildExecutionStarted` → `UpdateWorkflowExecution` → SQL commit fails

## Impact

- Child workflows fail to execute when parent workflow tasks complete and start children
- Observed with `temporal operator namespace delete` (starts reclaim-resources child)
- Likely affects any workflow pattern that starts child workflows
- Creates permanent shard churn (re-acquisition every ~5-6s)

## Relationship to Other Issues

This bug was hidden by [#10320](https://github.com/temporalio/temporal/issues/10320) (first workflow task hang) in most test runs. It only manifested when the parent workflow task completed successfully, which occurred during active shard churn that accidentally cleared the matching service's stale state.

## Transfer Queue Error Stack Trace

When the `TransferStartChildExecution` task fails, here's the error handling stack:

```
Error: UpdateWorkflowExecution operation failed. Failed to commit transaction. 
       Error: sql: transaction has already been committed or rolled back

Stack trace:
go.temporal.io/server/common/log.(*zapLogger).Error
	/home/runner/work/temporal/temporal/common/log/zap_logger.go:158
go.temporal.io/server/service/history/queues.(*executableImpl).HandleErr
	/home/runner/work/temporal/temporal/service/history/queues/executable.go:550
go.temporal.io/server/common/tasks.(*FIFOScheduler[...]).executeTask.func1
	/home/runner/work/temporal/temporal/common/tasks/fifo_scheduler.go:195
go.temporal.io/server/common/backoff.ThrottleRetry.func1
	/home/runner/work/temporal/temporal/common/backoff/retry.go:41

	/home/runner/work/temporal/temporal/common/tasks/fifo_scheduler.go:204
go.temporal.io/server/common/tasks.(*FIFOScheduler[...]).processTask
	/home/runner/work/temporal/temporal/common/tasks/fifo_scheduler.go:182
```

## Detailed Timeline with Shard Churn

The error triggers rapid shard re-acquisition. Here's the pattern from server logs:

```
00:53:27.636  Workflow started (temporal-sys-delete-namespace-workflow)
00:53:29.870  Generated new name for deleted namespace
00:53:31.150  Namespace renamed successfully

00:53:32.870  "Workflow is busy" (frontend)
00:53:34.165  "Workflow is busy" (frontend)
00:53:35.636  "Workflow is busy" (frontend)

00:53:37.427  First SQL transaction error (attempt 2)
00:53:38.062  Shard 1 range updated: 4 → 5
00:53:38.062  Shard 1 acquired

00:53:43.318  SQL transaction error (attempt 8)
00:53:43.957  Shard 1 range updated: 5 → 6
00:53:43.957  Shard 1 acquired

00:53:46.319  Context deadline exceeded (attempt 9)
00:53:53.447  Shard 1 range updated: 6 → 7
00:53:53.447  Shard 1 acquired

00:53:52.809  SQL transaction error (attempt 12)
00:54:05.435  Shard 1 range updated: 7 → 8
00:54:05.435  Shard 1 acquired

00:53:58.237  Context deadline exceeded (attempt 13)
00:54:15.795  Shard 1 range updated: 8 → 9
00:54:15.795  Shard 1 acquired

00:54:04.111  SQL transaction error (attempt 16)
00:54:38.569  Shard 1 range updated: 9 → 10
00:54:38.569  Shard 1 acquired

00:54:17.239  Context deadline exceeded (attempt 17)
00:55:04.289  Shard 1 range updated: 10 → 11
00:55:04.289  Shard 1 acquired

00:54:25.609  SQL transaction error (attempt 20)
00:55:23.657  Shard 1 range updated: 11 → 12
...continues
```

Pattern repeats: transfer task retries alternate between `sql: transaction has already been committed or rolled back` and `context deadline exceeded`, each failure triggering shard re-acquisition every ~5-10 seconds.

Over the 10-minute observation window, shard 1 was re-acquired 25+ times (range ID went from 4 to 15+).

## Complete Error Logs Showing the Race Condition

### Before the Error: Parent Workflow Completes Successfully

```json
{"level":"info","ts":"2026-05-19T00:53:27.636Z","msg":"Workflow started.",
 "wf-namespace":"temporal-system",
 "wf-id":"temporal-sys-delete-namespace-workflow/smoke-test"}

{"level":"info","ts":"2026-05-19T00:53:29.870Z","msg":"Generated new name for deleted namespace.",
 "wf-namespace":"smoke-test","new-name":"smoke-test-deleted-ba6f9"}

{"level":"info","ts":"2026-05-19T00:53:30.687Z","msg":"Stopped physicalTaskQueueManager",
 "wf-task-queue-name":"temporal-sys-per-ns-tq"}

{"level":"info","ts":"2026-05-19T00:53:30.688Z","msg":"Stopped Worker",
 "Namespace":"smoke-test","TaskQueue":"temporal-sys-per-ns-tq"}

{"level":"info","ts":"2026-05-19T00:53:31.150Z","msg":"Namespace renamed successfully.",
 "wf-namespace":"smoke-test","wf-namespace":"smoke-test-deleted-ba6f9"}
```

At this point, the parent workflow task has completed and written event 11 (`StartChildWorkflowExecutionInitiated`).

### "Workflow is busy" - Concurrent Access Detected

Frontend service logs show concurrent access attempts to the parent workflow:

```json
{"level":"info","ts":"2026-05-19T00:53:32.870Z","msg":"history client encountered error",
 "service":"frontend","error":"Workflow is busy.",
 "service-error-type":"serviceerror.ResourceExhausted"}

{"level":"info","ts":"2026-05-19T00:53:34.165Z","msg":"history client encountered error",
 "service":"frontend","error":"Workflow is busy.",
 "service-error-type":"serviceerror.ResourceExhausted"}

{"level":"info","ts":"2026-05-19T00:53:35.636Z","msg":"history client encountered error",
 "service":"frontend","error":"Workflow is busy.",
 "service-error-type":"serviceerror.ResourceExhausted"}
```

This indicates the workflow task completion path still holds a lock/transaction.

### SQL Transaction Error - Race Manifests

Transfer queue processor tries to update the parent workflow to record child started:

```json
{"level":"error","ts":"2026-05-19T00:53:37.427Z",
 "msg":"Operation failed with internal error.",
 "error":"UpdateWorkflowExecution operation failed. Failed to commit transaction. Error: sql: transaction has already been committed or rolled back",
 "error-type":"serviceerror.Unavailable",
 "operation":"UpdateWorkflowExecution"}

{"level":"error","ts":"2026-05-19T00:53:37.427Z",
 "msg":"Update workflow execution operation failed.",
 "error":"UpdateWorkflowExecution operation failed. Failed to commit transaction. Error: sql: transaction has already been committed or rolled back"}

{"level":"warn","ts":"2026-05-19T00:53:37.427Z","msg":"Fail to process task",
 "shard-id":1,"component":"transfer-queue-processor",
 "wf-namespace-id":"32049b68-7872-4094-8e63-d0dd59896a83",
 "wf-id":"temporal-sys-delete-namespace-workflow/smoke-test",
 "wf-run-id":"019e3db9-0d85-71e6-a804-ad333cbe13f7",
 "queue-task-key":{"FireTime":"1970-01-01T00:00:00Z","TaskID":4194335},
 "queue-task-type":"TransferStartChildExecution",
 "queue-task":"StartChildExecutionTask{WorkflowKey: 32049b68-7872-4094-8e63-d0dd59896a83/temporal-sys-delete-namespace-workflow/smoke-test/019e3db9-0d85-71e6-a804-ad333cbe13f7, VisibilityTimestamp: 2026-05-19 00:53:31.152773336 +0000 UTC, TaskID: 4194335, TargetNamespaceID: 32049b68-7872-4094-8e63-d0dd59896a83, TargetWorkflowID: temporal-sys-reclaim-namespace-resources-workflow/smoke-test-deleted-ba6f9, InitiatedEventID: 11, Version: 0}",
 "wf-history-event-id":11,
 "error":"UpdateWorkflowExecution operation failed. Failed to commit transaction. Error: sql: transaction has already been committed or rolled back",
 "error-type":"serviceerror.Unavailable",
 "attempt":2,"unexpected-error-attempts":1,
 "lifecycle":"ProcessingFailed","task-category":"transfer"}
```

### Shard Churn Triggered

Immediately after the error, shard re-acquisition begins:

```json
{"level":"info","ts":"2026-05-19T00:53:38.062Z","msg":"Range updated for shardID",
 "shard-id":1,"shard-range-id":5,"previous-shard-range-id":4}

{"level":"info","ts":"2026-05-19T00:53:38.062Z","msg":"Acquired shard",
 "shard-id":1}
```

### Retry Pattern - Alternating Errors

Subsequent retries alternate between the SQL transaction error and deadline exceeded:

```json
{"level":"warn","ts":"2026-05-19T00:53:43.318Z","msg":"Fail to process task",
 "queue-task-type":"TransferStartChildExecution",
 "error":"UpdateWorkflowExecution operation failed. Failed to commit transaction. Error: sql: transaction has already been committed or rolled back",
 "attempt":8,"unexpected-error-attempts":2}

{"level":"info","ts":"2026-05-19T00:53:43.957Z","msg":"Range updated for shardID",
 "shard-id":1,"shard-range-id":6,"previous-shard-range-id":5}

{"level":"warn","ts":"2026-05-19T00:53:46.319Z","msg":"Fail to process task",
 "queue-task-type":"TransferStartChildExecution",
 "error":"context deadline exceeded",
 "error-type":"serviceerror.DeadlineExceeded",
 "attempt":9,"unexpected-error-attempts":3}

{"level":"warn","ts":"2026-05-19T00:53:52.809Z","msg":"Fail to process task",
 "queue-task-type":"TransferStartChildExecution",
 "error":"UpdateWorkflowExecution operation failed. Failed to commit transaction. Error: sql: transaction has already been committed or rolled back",
 "attempt":12,"unexpected-error-attempts":4}

{"level":"info","ts":"2026-05-19T00:53:53.447Z","msg":"Range updated for shardID",
 "shard-id":1,"shard-range-id":7,"previous-shard-range-id":6}

{"level":"warn","ts":"2026-05-19T00:53:58.237Z","msg":"Fail to process task",
 "queue-task-type":"TransferStartChildExecution",
 "error":"context deadline exceeded",
 "attempt":13,"unexpected-error-attempts":5}
```

This pattern continues indefinitely. Over 10 minutes, 25+ shard re-acquisitions occurred (range ID went from 4 to 15+).

### Child Workflow State

Meanwhile, the child workflow was created but never executes:

```
ID  Time                     Type
 1  2026-05-19T00:53:31Z     WorkflowExecutionStarted
```

No `WorkflowTaskScheduled` event ever gets written because `TransferStartChildExecution` keeps failing.

title: SQL transaction race in TransferStartChildExecution causes permanent workflow stall
